collect.li1: Name, student ID and email, from your university’s roster.
collect.li2: Exam events: what happened and when, like “looked away, 2.3 s, 10:43”.
collect.li3: Flagged frames: single still images taken at the moment of a flag.
collect.li4: The identity check result: matched, or needs help.
collect.li5: Laptop details: operating system, Üki version and system check results.

retention.li1: Flagged frames and events: 90 days, then deleted.

retention.li3: Staff accounts: until the university closes them.

rights.p1: You can ask for a copy of your data, a correction or deletion. Use the Privacy centre through your exam office, or write to privacy@uki.test. Each request gets a due date and a record. You can also complain to the authorised body for personal data protection in Kazakhstan.
rights.title: Your rights

privacyPolicy.short1: Video and audio stay on your laptop. Üki never uploads them.
privacyPolicy.short2: Üki keeps events and a few flagged frames for 90 days, in Kazakhstan.
privacyPolicy.short3: Your university decides how exams run. Üki processes data for it.
privacyPolicy.short4: Ask for a copy or deletion at any time.

staysOnLaptop.li1: Webcam video. Üki checks it frame by frame on your laptop and never uploads it.
staysOnLaptop.li3: The photo of your student card and your face. Üki compares them on your laptop and deletes them after the check.
staysOnLaptop.title: What stays on your laptop

storage.p1: On servers in Kazakhstan. Üki doesn’t transfer exam data abroad.
storage.title: Where it is stored

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy

whoWeAre.p1: Üki is an online proctoring service for university exams, made by the Üki team in Kostanay, Kazakhstan. When your university runs an exam with Üki, the university decides how your data is used, and Üki processes it on the university’s behalf.
whoWeAre.title: Who we are

why.li1: To run the exam your university set up.
why.li2: To show proctors the moments that need a decision.
why.li3: To produce integrity reports that a person signs off.
why.li4: To keep the service secure and fix problems.
why.title: Why we use it

accounts.li1: Staff accounts start from an invitation by the exam office.
accounts.li2: Students join an exam with a code and their student ID. No account needed.
accounts.li3: Keep your password to yourself. Tell your exam office if someone else used it.
accounts.title: Accounts

audience.p1: Students, proctors and exam office staff at universities that use Üki. If anything here differs from the agreement between your university and Üki, the agreement wins.
audience.title: Who these terms are for

availability.p1: During the pilot, the Üki team is on call for every scheduled exam. If Üki stops during an exam, answers saved on the laptop are kept and the exam office decides what happens next.
availability.title: Availability

data.p1: The Privacy policy explains what Üki collects, where it’s stored and for how long.
data.title: Data

ending.p1: Your university can close accounts at any time. Data is then deleted on the schedule in the Privacy policy.
ending.title: Ending use

exam.li1: Install Üki and Üki Lock on the laptop you write on.
exam.li2: Run the system check before exam day.
exam.li3: Follow the rules your university set for the exam. Üki shows them before the start.
exam.title: Using Üki in an exam

flags.p1: Üki marks moments, like a phone in the frame. It doesn’t decide what they mean. A proctor reviews each flag, and the report records the decision and who made it. Students can ask the exam office to look at a decision again.
flags.title: Flags and decisions

law.p1: These terms follow the law of the Republic of Kazakhstan. Questions: legal@uki.test · Üki, Kostanay, Kazakhstan.
law.title: Law and contact

liability.p1: Üki’s responsibility is set in the agreement with your university. Nothing here limits rights you have under the law of the Republic of Kazakhstan.
liability.title: Liability

mustNot.li1: Get around Üki Lock, the camera checks or the timer.
mustNot.li2: Change, copy or reverse-engineer the app.
mustNot.li3: Use Üki to watch anyone outside an exam.
mustNot.li4: Share exam content your university marked as confidential.
mustNot.title: What you must not do

termsOfUse.short1: Your university signs the agreement with Üki. These terms cover how people use Üki.
termsOfUse.short2: Use Üki only for exams your university set up.
termsOfUse.short3: A flag isn’t a verdict. People decide, and the report shows who.
termsOfUse.short4: Don’t try to get around the lock or change the app.
termsOfUse.title: Terms of use
